incident-bot: :rotating_light: PD: billing-ingest-backlog triggered (high consumer lag)

Raj (oncall): acked. I'm diving in.

Raj (oncall): alert shows sustained consumer lag on billing-ingest topic across eu-west-1 and us-west-2, offsets piling up.

pagerduty: Incident #PD-98234 created by alerting-rule:billing.consumer-lag > 100k

Emma (eng-runtime): seeing a spike in incoming request rate + upstream retry storms in the logs. Possibly a client retry loop.

Liam (sre): any customer-facing impact yet?

Sophia (billing): potential — if lag persists, aggregation windows won't close and a subset of invoices (end-of-day) could be missing tokens -> invoice underreporting risk. Need ETA on mitigation.

Raj (oncall): starting mitigation: temporarily increase consumer parallelism for billing-ingest-worker deployment and enable fast-forward checkpointing.

Raj (oncall): running: `kubectl -n billing scale deploy billing-ingest-worker --replicas=12`

Emma (eng-runtime): also enabling consumer backpressure limit in proxy to stop upstream retries: patching config now.

Emma (eng-runtime): config snippet:
```
consumer.max.inflight=256
retry.backoff.ms=1000
```

incident-bot: runbook link: <https://confluence.redwood.ai/runbooks/billing-ingest|billing-ingest runbook>

Liam (sre): I'm tailing consumer lag metrics. Current total lag: 1.2M messages, throughput doubling after scale.

Sophia (billing): Notifying finance ops: possible invoice delay for customers with >100k tokens/day. Will prepare communication if unresolved by EOD.

Raj (oncall): temporary mitigation looks effective, lag decreasing to 600k after 6m. Keeping bridge open.

Emma (eng-runtime): found noisy client: `api-key: svc-legacy-metrics` sending duplicate batches. Adding a short-term filter rule to drop duplicates.

Raj (oncall): applied filter rule in routing: `if client == svc-legacy-metrics and duplicate > 1 -> drop`

Liam (sre): backlog drain rate steady at ~80k msg/min. At this rate we should be at safe thresholds in ~8-9 minutes, assuming no new spike.

Sophia (billing): estimating customer impact: ~230 customers might see delayed tokens; invoicing calculations for those customers may be incomplete until backlog drains.

Emma (eng-runtime): scheduling a backfill job for any missed windows after drain. Will create ticket for targeted reconciliation.

Raj (oncall): handing off to Liam for overnight monitoring at 02:00 UTC — I'll update PD with handoff note.

Raj (oncall): PD note: Acknowledged. Mitigation applied (scaled consumers, duplicate filter). Backlog decreasing from 1.2M -> 200k. Handoff to Liam at 02:00 UTC.

pagerduty: PD: Acknowledgement recorded by Raj. Next escalation in 15m if unacknowledged: oncall-schedule.

Liam (sre): acked handoff. I'll keep bridge and runbook open. If backlog stalls > 400k, escalate to eng-runtime and exec.

Emma (eng-runtime): follow-ups: 1) add preventative guard for duplicate-batcher client, 2) run chaos test on retry storm detection, 3) add a circuit breaker to client ingestion path. I'll file PRs.

Sophia (billing): finance ops will hold invoices for affected customers until reconciliation completes. We'll coordinate messaging with support.

Support-bot: Created ticket #SUP-447 for customer comms draft (assigned to Support lead).

Liam (sre): status update 02:10 UTC — backlog at 58k, consumer CPU stable, no new spikes.

Raj (oncall): thanks team. Marking incident as mitigated but not resolved. Will remain open until backfill completes and reconciliation validated.

incident-bot: Incident status changed: Mitigated -> Monitoring.

Emma (eng-runtime): deploying duplicate-filter in staging and prod PR opened: <https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/billing/merge/1234|PR#1234>. Expected rollout window 30m.

Sophia (billing): finance ops: will run reconciliation job tomorrow morning and will confirm invoice state.

Liam (sre): closing bridge in 15m if no regressions. Leaving a follow-up action list: `postmortem`, `client outreach`, `metrics alert tuning`, `preventative PRs`.

Raj (oncall): final note: root cause preliminary: noisy legacy client + insufficient ingestion backpressure. Long-term fix: client deprecation + server-side circuit breaker.

incident-bot: Incident resolved? NO — needs reconciliation.

Raj (oncall): adding owners to follow-ups: Emma (eng-runtime), Sophia (billing), Liam (sre). I'll reopen if we see new lag.

Sophia (billing): thanks. I'll update finance ops and schedule reconciliation run.

Liam (sre): signing off monitoring shift. Will ping if anything changes. :white_check_mark:

- Reconciliation job and invoice hold release (Sophia)
